mapper.select: SELECT cs.*, a.area_name AS area_name, u1.user_name AS manager_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u2.user_name), '') AS cleaners_name_str, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.name), '') AS facilitys_name_str, u3.user_name AS report_name, u4.user_name AS handle_name, ms.name AS maintain_status_name, pt.name AS problem_type_name, hs.name AS handle_status_name, v.license_plate AS vehicle_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u5.user_name), '') AS staffs_name_str, ps.name AS plan_status_name, tt.name AS task_type_name FROM commercial_street cs LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON cs.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON cs.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON cs.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON FIND_IN_SET( u2.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(cs.cleaner_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_facility f ON FIND_IN_SET( f.sys_facility_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(cs.facility_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON cs.report_by = u3.user_id AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u4 ON cs.handle_by = u4.user_id AND u4.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_maintain_status ms ON cs.maintain_status_id = ms.sys_maintain_status_id AND ms.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_problem_type pt ON cs.problem_type_id = pt.sys_problem_type_id AND pt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_handle_status hs ON cs.handle_status_id = hs.sys_handle_status_id AND hs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON cs.vehicle_id = v.sys_vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u5 ON FIND_IN_SET( u5.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(cs.staff_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u5.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON cs.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type tt ON cs.task_type_id = tt.sys_task_type_id AND tt.deleted = 0 WHERE cs.deleted = 0 GROUP BY cs.id, a.area_name, u1.user_name, os.name, u3.user_name, u4.user_name, ms.name, pt.name, hs.name, v.license_plate, ps.name, tt.name ORDER BY cs.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
